text_blocks.snippet: Healthcare workers are experiencing a mental health crisis marked by burnout, increased harassment, and high turnover intention. Many are facing challenges stemming from the realities of the healthcare system, leading to negative impacts on their mental well-being and a desire to leave their professions.

list.title: Burnout:
list.snippet: A significant number of healthcare workers report experiencing burnout, with rates increasing from 2018 to 2022, according to the CDC. In 2022, 46% of healthcare workers reported feeling burned out often or very often, compared to 32% in 2018.

list.title: Harassment:
list.snippet: The percentage of healthcare workers reporting harassment more than doubled, from 6% in 2018 to 13% in 2022.

list.title: Trust in Management:
list.snippet: Trust in management among healthcare workers decreased from 84% in 2018 to 78% in 2022, according to the CDC.
